answers.in-scope-brainrocket-en:
Ivan is a **Senior Markup Developer | UI Engineering** at BrainRocket, working on iGaming platforms. He builds responsive interfaces and reusable components using HTML, SCSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular.

He also reviews code, investigates UI and performance issues, mentors and onboards developers, and supports releases.
answers.in-scope-stack-en:
Ivan’s core frontend technologies are **HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript and TypeScript**. He also works with Angular, BEM, Git/GitLab, Figma and npm, and has some experience with Bun.

His main strength is UI, markup and component implementation rather than application-level Angular or TypeScript logic. He also uses Claude Code and other AI tools in his daily work.
answers.in-scope-numbersvalidator-en: NumbersValidator is a production web tool Ivan built at Liketelecom to clean, validate and convert phone numbers. It can process individual numbers or batches from XLS/XLSX files, and detect details such as number type and region.
answers.in-scope-rag-en:
The site’s RAG assistant, Elio, answers questions about Ivan’s experience using a Python-based AI core, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and PostgreSQL with pgvector. Answers are streamed alongside a live map of the sources used.

For ingestion, source texts are split into chunks and hashed. Unchanged chunks keep their embeddings; only text with an unknown hash is embedded. An estimate mode previews the plan and cost without making embedding calls, while apply mode embeds and writes the data.
answers.in-scope-liketelecom-en: Ivan worked at Liketelecom from June 2016 to October 2024—about **8 years and 4 months**.
